rules.description: An agent only takes calls in a language listed among their skills.
At least 13 hours between the end of one shift and the start of the agent's next shift (so at most one shift a day).
Full-timers work only 8-hour shifts, part-timers only 4-hour shifts.
A full-timer works at most 6 shifts a week, a part-timer at most 3.
Nobody is scheduled on a day of approved leave.
The agent in the team lead's note is not scheduled on any day up to and including Thursday 12 November, the last day of their doctor's certificate.
Whenever a new hire is on the phones, at least one non-new agent is on the same language at the same time.
